name: barebars-monorepo
description: BareBars — a template-engine construction kit. PureScript monorepo: core library, CLI, and web playground.

scripts.test: spago test -p barebars && spago test -p fullbars && spago test -p barebars-json && spago test -p barebars-js && spago test -p barebars-compile && npm run check:catalog && npm run check:isolation && npm run test:compile && npm run examples:verify
scripts.examples:verify: spago build -p barebars-cli && spago run -p barebars-cli -- examples verify
